test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Why did TRAI meet various service providers?

options.text: to make new regulations at state level
to direct them to improve services
to add new licence service areas

solution:
The correct answer is** "to direct them to improve services".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage clearly states that TRAI's meeting with telecom service providers was aimed at issuing directives to improve their services. 
 
• In the meeting, TRAI asked the telecom service providers to urgently improve the quality of service and the quality of experience of consumers.
 
• While issues such as new regulations at the state-level or adding new license service areas may have been discussed, the main aim was to correct noted service deficits.
 
• The meeting did not focus on increasing the customer base, making it irrelevant to the correct response.

**Hence, the correct answer is 'Option 3'.**
